text: convertAttachment derives contentDisposition from the first header value, strips parameters, trims/lowercases it and defaults to attachment if absent. It separately returns headers through convertHeaders. The schema keeps a string rather than an enum, so attachment/inline are examples rather than the only possible values. Preserve raw header names in dictionary keys and semantic lowerCamelCase fields at the API boundary; the established contentDisposition naming lesson is reused. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Expose normalized attachment disposition alongside the full header values
